lines: Reverted a change that stopped sloped platform hoiks from working.
Reverted a change that caused Leaf Blocks and Rich Mahogany Leaf Blocks to merge with each other.
Obsidian Swordfish's fire projectiles now inflict Hellfire rather than On Fire!.
Fixed the game being unable to start on certain iOS versions.
Fixed a crash related to Proton. Proton in general is not supported or necessary to run Terraria.
Fixed a crash caused by entering a seed that only contains special characters.
Fixed resource packs not checking the width and height of textures properly.
Fixed the Shimmer island in Skyblock + Don't Dig Up worlds spawning partially out of bounds.
Fixed several crashes caused by the above.
Fixed several localization issues.
Fixed Villagers only being able to arrive homeless even if there are valid houses.
Fixed some ammo using weapons (such as Acorn Slingshot) showing both stack count and ammo count at the same time, causing an overlap.
Fixed instruments (including weapons like the Magic Harp) not having the correct range on all resolutions.
Fixed Confetti and Snowfall blocks not blocking drawing behind them in all cases.
Fixed several cases where right-clicking would cause multiple simultaneous interactions.
Fixed the Rainbow Phasesaber's hitbox being the wrong size.
Fixed minions being killed when they leave the world's bounds. They will now teleport back to the player instead.
Fixed fishing not resetting the kite AFK counter.
Fixed an exploit that allowed you to create items for free from the crafting menu.
Fixed an exploit that allowed you to duplicate items that deal damage to you when used.
Fixed the research cost of items not being visible in the crafting menu.
Fixed Abigail and the Desert Storm Tiger not benefiting from Summon weapon prefixes.
Fixed the Lavaproof Fishing Bag having a black pixel in all frames but the first.
Fixed a missing pixel in the Wooden Table.
